role: Decorative ground texture. Contains no routes, hazards, tools or task triggers. Game geometry and events remain authoritative in the shared rules engine.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless terrain texture for a 2D top-down exploration game. Create an entirely overhead, orthographic painted game ground tile, landscape 3:2 aspect ratio. A lush muted green upland meadow with natural patches of tiny grasses, moss, subtle olive and sage vegetation, scattered exposed earthy soil and occasional very small stones. Soft hand-painted gouache texture with crisp game-art readability, like a beautifully crafted indie adventure environment. It must work as the continuous ground underneath separately rendered lake water, trees, rocks, camps, walking paths and a backpacking character. Ground ONLY: no trees, no houses, no tents, no lake, no water, no large objects, no paths, no roads, no landmarks, no animals, no text, no labels, no UI, no borders, no perspective, no sky. Uniform light from upper left, gentle natural variation across the whole image, no strong central composition, no vignette. Seamless/tileable texture with matching opposite edges, subtle variation rather than repeated visible symbols. Moderate dark forest-green values with lighter olive grassy areas, designed to remain legible behind cream and warm-gold map paths.
other_art: Lake shoreline follows the existing public schematic. Vegetation, rock, tent, waypoint and explorer drawings are native SVG code in static/scene.js. Decoration seed is fixed and independent of hidden game metadata. Known-location artwork and effects use only public observations.
